reason: Backend lint/test gates for platform submission, idempotency, stale detection, and failure handling.
Frontend lint/type-check/build gates for guided-submit UI.
Verify every platform failure persists sanitized envelope data and timeline events.
Verify adapter isolation and no unsafe platform side effects during prepare/dry-run.
Verify payload hash/source hash/idempotency flow across UI, API, service, worker, storage.

summary: Safety contracts, fake adapter, H1/H2 tests, API/UI wiring, and migration checks pass, but the task is not fully acceptable as the first BOSS guided-submit pilot because the env-gated RealBossAdapter still has no Playwright navigation/fill implementation.

fixes_applied.summary: Changed RealBossAdapter stub so prepare returns platform_unknown_result and submit returns unknown instead of synthesizing a submitted result.
Made the registry test robust whether Playwright is installed or missing.

blocking_findings.summary: PRD acceptance requires BOSS dry-run navigation + fill end-to-end, but backend/app/platforms/boss/adapter.py explicitly defers full Playwright navigation/fill/final-submit logic to a follow-up. Current behavior proves the safety contracts with a fake adapter but cannot run the real platform pilot.

non_blocking_risks.summary: Frontend guided-submit panel can prepare and submit only after its local action state is populated from submit/abort responses; after a successful prepare it points the user to the sibling approval panel rather than hydrating the new action directly. This is acceptable for the safety-contract phase but should be polished with a detail endpoint or action-list refresh before real pilot UX.

summary: Rechecked after fixing frontend action hydration. All automated checks pass, and the approval-to-submit frontend loop is now wired, but the full task still cannot be accepted as a real BOSS guided-submit pilot until Playwright navigation/fill/classification is implemented in RealBossAdapter.

fixes_applied.summary: GuidedSubmitPanel now hydrates the latest platform_submit ApplicationAction via listApplicationActions after prepare and after parent application refresh.
ApplicationActionsPanel now notifies its parent after create/approve/revoke so sibling panels can refresh.
ApplicationActionOut frontend type now includes external idempotency/result fields returned by the backend.

blocking_findings.summary: Real BOSS Web adapter still returns safe unknown outcomes and does not perform Playwright navigation/fill/classification. This intentionally avoids false submitted results, but it means the PRD acceptance item 'Dry-run navigation + fill works end-to-end' is not yet satisfied for the real platform.

resolved_findings.summary: Frontend approval-to-submit loop was incomplete; fixed by refreshing platform_submit actions after prepare and approval changes.
RealBossAdapter previously synthesized submitted results; fixed to return unknown until real browser logic exists.
